study_identification_part.si4_title: Revealing Individual Neuroanatomical Heterogeneity in Alzheimer Disease Using Neuroanatomical Normative Modeling

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Apply neuroanatomical normative modeling of cortical thickness to characterize individual-level heterogeneity and outliers in AD, MCI, and controls, relate heterogeneity to cognition and CSF biomarkers, and test whether heterogeneity predicts conversion from MCI to AD.

rci1_dataset_name.answer: ABCD; Cam-CAN; CMI; CNP; FCON; HCP; HCPAG; HCPDV; HCP Early Psychosis; IXI; NKI-Rockland; OASIS-3; OPN; PNC; TOP; UK Biobank

rci2_hc_n.reason: The paper clearly states the total number of healthy controls in the reference dataset. This number represents the analyzed participants used for training the normative model.
rci2_hc_n.supporting_text: In the reference data set, a total of n = 33,072 T1-weighted MRI scans were collated across 60 sites

rci5_imaging_modality.reason: Both clinical and reference datasets used T1-weighted MRI for cortical thickness estimation.
rci5_imaging_modality.supporting_text: "T1-weighted images were acquired at multiple sites..."; "Cortical thickness measurements... were obtained from T1-weighted MRI scans..."

rci9_site_effect_handling.detail: Hierarchical Bayesian regression with site/group effects; parameters pooled via shared priors across sites; transfer learning calibration to ADNI using 70% of controls per site, then applied to the remaining 30% controls + MCI + AD.
rci9_site_effect_handling.supporting_text: "...adaptively pools parameter estimates across sites via a shared prior over regression parameters across sites. This simultaneously accounts for intersite variation..."; "...parameters of the reference normative model were recalibrated to the ADNI data set using 70% of healthy controls per ADNI site... The remaining 30% of healthy controls plus MCI and patients with AD were used..."

nm1_model_origin.supporting_text: "In the reference data set, a total of n = 33,072... across 60 sites..."; "The parameters of the reference normative model were recalibrated to the ADNI data set using 70% of healthy controls per ADNI site..."; "All modeling steps are performed using PCNtoolkit (version 0.20)."

caa2_diseases_studied.reason: The target groups were AD and MCI (with controls).

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Individualized cortical thickness z-score maps reveal heterogeneous regional atrophy in AD; higher total outlier burden relates to poorer cognition, adverse CSF biomarkers, and greater risk of MCI→AD conversion.
